metadata.description: Agentic Spec-Driven Development methodology for code assistants: a PRD/ARCHITECTURE-driven build loop, packaged as a reusable plugin.

plugins.name: sdd-loop
plugins.description: SDD outer loop + BDD/TDD double inner loop, driven from a stakeholder-validated PRD.md and a dev-validated ARCHITECTURE.md. Bootstrap with /sdd-init; orchestrates /to-prd, /to-issues, /bdd, /tdd, /grill-me, /handoff and /loop via a per-issue dispatcher. Project-agnostic: each repo supplies a .sdd/profile.md.
